name: Toth
source:
Occupation: Lumberjack's son.
Hobbies: Worrying.
Gift: Random.

The protagonist of "Wonderland World". Toth is kind and altruistic, always eager to help people in distress. Although he isn't very quick on his legs, he has a keen mind that he will use to question any thing he has doubt in. In addition to this, he pays attention to detail and carefully listens to various people. Toth often hangs around with his younger half-sister Pokke, and with his childhood friend Evanna. He is highly protective of his childhood friend, he would never leave her when she is in trouble.

[Translated from [url=http://web.archive.org/web/20160301131631/http://www.circletempo.net/WD/]official website[/url].]
